[Semantic contract research — recommendations only](developer-contract-research-independent.md#independentshellcommand). Native requirements, legacy observations and proposed regression expectations remain separate.

### Recorded semantic rules

- `independent.shellcommand.filter_state_capability`: Every Set filter State reference must resolve to capability independent.shellcommand.
- `independent.shellcommand.pattern_semantics`: When object.pattern is present it is a regular expression applied to stdout lines; matching output lines and capture subexpressions remain separately observable.
- `independent.shellcommand.trusted_content`: Execution of publisher-supplied commands is trust-sensitive. Package/signature verification policy SHALL be enforced outside the command string itself and scanners SHOULD avoid executing unsigned or untrusted content according to deployment policy.
- `independent.shellcommand.not_generic_escape_hatch`: This capability represents command-oriented assessment. It SHALL NOT replace native scanner capabilities when doing so would discard meaningful native collection semantics such as controlled filesystem traversal, structured evidence, or bounded collection.

- `independent.xmlfilecontent.full_path_no_traversal`: Traversal is not permitted when full_path selection is used.

- `independent.xmlfilecontent.materialized_item_creation`: Direct native Objects explicitly carry item_creation; importers SHALL materialize the OVAL default all_object_elements_fullfilled.
